CreditorPayments.title: Creditor payments
CreditorPayments.body: Here you select open vendor bills and generate a payment file your e-banking reads. TILL transfers nothing itself: you download the file and release it at your bank. Only once the bank has executed do you mark the batch as paid here; only then do the bills count as settled.
